items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued July 11 at 6:15AM AKDT until July 11 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility as low as 1/4 mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...Petersburg Borough.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make travel by vehicle, boat, or
plane difficult.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued July 11 at 2:04AM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Recent
rainfall has loosened soil and root systems, which could lead to
downed trees and a few power outages.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 11 at 2:04AM AKDT until July 11 at 11:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 degrees.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The warmest temperatures will be away from
the Yukon River.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids and check up on elderly and vulnerable
relatives and neighbors.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued July 11 at 12:27AM AKDT until July 11 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* Winds...Southeast 15 to 25 mph. Gusts up to 40 mph.

* Timing...Hot, dry, windy conditions expected to begin by noon,
persisting into this evening, as temperatures cool by 7pm.

* Relative Humidity...As low as 20 percent.

* Temperatures...In the lower to mid 70s for lower elevations.

* Location...Areas along the Copper and Chitina Rivers.

* Impacts...Rapid ignition, growth and spread of fires will be
possible.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 10 at 12:16PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
South winds will increase from 12PM to 10PM Saturday with gusts
to around 40 mph. The recent heavy rain has loosened soil and root
systems making the trees more susceptible to falling. Wind gusts
up to 40 mph can result in downed trees and isolated power
outages during this time.

If you see downed trees or power lines, please notify authorities
and do not approach them as it can be hazardous.
